_comment: Role-family pattern library for the AI phrasing engine. Each family contains metric categories relevant to that role, bullet templates with [PLACEHOLDER] syntax, and prompt guidance injected into the AI system prompt. Update patterns here — no application logic changes required.

f-and-b-service.label: F&B Service
metrics: upsell percentage or revenue uplift (e.g. upsell rate 22%)
f-and-b-service.promptGuidance: The user works in F&B service (waiter, waitress, dining room roles). Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: covers per shift, upsell %, guest satisfaction scores, team size, and venue star rating. If the user mentions a number (covers, %, team size), use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [X covers/shift] or [X%] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Delivered [service style] service for [X covers/shift] covers per shift across [venue type].
Achieved [X%] upsell rate on premium wine and cocktail pairings, contributing to [revenue outcome].
Maintained [X/5] guest satisfaction score across [X] service periods.
Led a team of [X] front-of-house staff during peak service in a [star-rating] restaurant.
Reduced average table turn time to [X minutes] without compromising guest experience.

bartending-sommelier.label: Bartending / Sommelier
metrics: revenue per shift or per week (e.g. £2,400/shift)
bar sales target achievement (e.g. 115% of target)
wine or cocktail list size managed (e.g. 420-bin wine list)
bartending-sommelier.promptGuidance: The user works in bartending or sommelier/wine roles. Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: revenue per shift, sales target %, upsell %, list/cellar size, inventory accuracy, and team managed. If the user mentions a number, use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [£X/shift] or [X% of target] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Generated average revenue of [£X per shift] across [bar type] venues, consistently exceeding weekly targets by [X%].
Curated and managed a [X-bin] wine list spanning [regions/styles], increasing wine covers by [X%].
Achieved [X%] upsell rate on premium spirits and cocktail upgrades.
Maintained [X%] inventory accuracy across [spirits/wine] stock through weekly cycle counts.
Trained and mentored [X] junior bar staff in mixology technique and responsible service standards.

housekeeping.label: Housekeeping
metrics: rooms or cabins serviced per shift (e.g. 18 cabins/shift)
inspection pass rate (e.g. 98% first-pass inspection rate)
guest satisfaction score for room cleanliness
housekeeping.promptGuidance: The user works in housekeeping (cabin steward, room attendant, housekeeping supervisor). Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: cabins/rooms serviced per shift, inspection pass rate, guest satisfaction scores, and team size. If the user mentions a number, use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [X cabins/shift] or [X% pass rate] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Serviced [X] cabins per shift to [star-rating] standards, maintaining a [X%] first-inspection pass rate.
Achieved [X/5] guest satisfaction score for room cleanliness across [X] consecutive voyages.
Supervised a team of [X] cabin attendants, coordinating turnaround schedule for [X] staterooms per sailing.
Reduced linen-error complaints by [X%] by implementing a pre-departure checklist system.
Completed daily turndown and deep-clean cycle for [X] allocated cabins within [X-hour] service window.

guest-services.label: Guest Services / Reception
guest-services.promptGuidance: The user works in guest services, front desk, or reception roles. Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: complaint resolution time, guest satisfaction scores, repeat-guest rate, volume of daily interactions, and team size. If the user mentions a number, use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [X-minute resolution] or [X/5 satisfaction] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Resolved guest complaints with average [X-minute] turnaround, achieving [X%] first-contact resolution rate.
Managed front desk operations handling [X] daily check-ins at a [star-rating] property.
Maintained [X/5] guest satisfaction score across [X] months of continuous operation.
Coordinated [X] shore excursion bookings per voyage, generating additional revenue of [£X] per sailing.
Supervised a front office team of [X], delivering 24-hour coverage across a [X]-cabin vessel.

entertainment-youth.label: Entertainment / Youth Staff
metrics: program attendance figures (e.g. 120 guests per session)
number of events or sessions hosted per voyage
age group or guest count managed
entertainment-youth.promptGuidance: The user works in onboard entertainment or youth programming. Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: session attendance, guest satisfaction/feedback scores, number of events hosted, and age groups managed. If the user mentions a number, use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [X guests/session] or [X/5 feedback] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Hosted [X] daily activity sessions across a [X]-day voyage, averaging [X] guest participants per event.
Achieved [X/5] end-of-cruise feedback rating for entertainment programming across [X] consecutive sailings.
Designed and delivered a [X]-session children's activity programme for [X] children aged [age range].
Increased deck activity participation by [X%] by introducing themed tournament formats.
MC'd [X] themed evening events per voyage for audiences of up to [X] guests.

galley-culinary.label: Galley / Culinary
metrics: covers served per service or per day (e.g. 400 covers/day)
food cost control % (e.g. food cost reduced to 28%)
team size managed (e.g. kitchen brigade of 12)
galley-culinary.promptGuidance: The user works in a galley or culinary role (chef, cook, kitchen brigade). Structure every achievement bullet as: strong action verb + task context + quantifiable result. The most valued metrics in this role family are: covers served per service, food cost %, kitchen team size, hygiene inspection scores, and prep efficiency. If the user mentions a number, use it exactly. If they describe an achievement without a number, leave a clearly marked placeholder like [X covers/service] or [X% food cost] — never invent a figure.
bulletTemplates: Prepared and executed service for [X] covers per sitting across [cuisine type] stations in a [star-rating] galley.
Maintained food cost at [X%] of revenue through portion control and FIFO stock rotation.
Achieved [X%] score on USPH/HACCP galley inspection with zero critical findings.
Managed a kitchen team of [X] across [X] stations, maintaining consistent output during back-to-back service.
Reduced prep time for [dish/course] by [X%] by restructuring mise en place workflow.
